actual_cost.description: posted cost, over the mapped cost codes

cause.description: the largest positive cost effect; absent when none is positive

committed_cost.description: open orders not yet received, over the mapped cost codes

complete_pct.description: the share of the activity complete, from 0 to 1

currency.description: the currency of every amount on this record (`priced_amount`, `priced_unit_cost`, `committed_cost`, `actual_cost`, `forecast_to_complete`, `variation_amount`), an ISO 4217 alpha-3 code. A record with no currency has no usable amount.

evidence_fact_ids.description: the facts the measurement read: the price, the map, the cost and progress facts

forecast_to_complete.description: the position divided by `complete_pct`, floored at the position

input_mismatch.description: true when the tendered rate or norm differs from that version by more than 2%

input_version.description: the `tender_input` version in force on the tender's date, or absent when there was none

input_version_basis.description: how the version was chosen: by the tender's date, or none in force

norm_ratio.description: hours per unit achieved over hours per unit priced; absent when either is

priced_unit_cost.description: the tendered rate per unit of quantity

qty_ratio.description: quantity built over quantity priced; absent when either is

rate_ratio.description: rate paid over rate priced; absent when either is

skipped_reason.description: why the activity could not be measured; required when it could not

state.description: whether the activity is inside the band or in breach

variation_amount.description: accepted variations netted out, at the level `variation_basis` names

variation_basis.description: where variations were netted: the job, or the activity

week_start.description: the Monday of the week the run measured

weeks_in_breach.description: consecutive weeks the activity's ratios have been outside the band
